capabilities: Jump to the next or previous heading from the cursor position
Open a switcher listing the current document's headings and jump to one
Open a switcher listing headings of all documents in the current folder
Wrap navigation to the file's start or end via an option
extras: README covers only commands and a changelog; no usage examples or screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands for moving between headings relative to the cursor or for picking a heading from the current folder's outlines.
summary: Heading navigation plugin that adds commands to jump to the next or previous heading and to open a switcher listing document headings.
